_doc: Fixed test-input set: the bench's measuring instrument. Every model judgment runs these briefs with fixed seeds so comparisons are evidence. Coverage: props for the 3D lane, environment/mood, stylized character, realistic keyart, and UI/text (for engines that can render text). role=region_source briefs mint the source images for bench/region_cases.json (SDXL rails, since region turns run there). Add briefs, never mutate existing ids: rows are comparable across time only if the brief stays frozen.
